issue: Mandatory plugins per Authentication Policy v1.0 are jwt, oauth2, key-auth, with GDPR mapping marking JWT Authentication as Mandatory. Service has oauth2 and key-auth but lacks jwt; basic-auth does not satisfy jwt requirement.
recommendedAction: Enable and configure the jwt plugin on KongTest service in Kong Gateway to comply with Authentication Policy v1.0
impact: Prevents unauthenticated access and ensures strong token-based authentication is enforced
securityStandardReference: OWASP API Top 10 2023 - API2:2023 Broken Authentication

issue: Service enables only key-auth; Authentication Policy v1.0 requires jwt and oauth2, and GDPR mapping marks JWT Authentication and OAuth2 as Mandatory for GDPR.
recommendedAction: Enable and configure jwt and oauth2 plugins on orders-api service in addition to key-auth to achieve full compliance with Authentication Policy v1.0
impact: Closes authentication gaps and enforces multi-method secure access control

issue: Enabled plugins [cors, request-transformer] do not include mandatory authentication plugins required for GDPR; JWT Authentication and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect are listed as Mandatory for GDPR.
recommendedAction: Enable and configure JWT Authentication and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect plugins on legacy-billing service to meet GDPR authentication requirements
impact: Ensures only authenticated access to PII and reduces risk of unauthorized data exposure

issue: Service has no plugins enabled, missing Mandatory GDPR plugins JWT Authentication and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect per Kong Gateway Plugins vs API Security Standards mapping.
recommendedAction: Enable and configure JWT Authentication and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect plugins on payments-api service with no plugins currently enabled
impact: Protects sensitive payment data by requiring authenticated access and preventing anonymous calls
